title: Close out Phase 2: PR, CI gate, retro, then plan the next phase
description:
INTEGRATION: per .tick/config.md, push the epic branch, open a PR, and do not complete close-out until .github/workflows/ci.yml is green on it. No direct merge to main.

Retro against kka's definition of done, verifying the CODE not the tick titles — above all, that drift demonstrably fails rather than merely being documented.

Then plan the next feasible phase. Phase 3 (9hu, the credentials split) and Phase 4b (9oy, retiring the Go Telegram poller) are both unblocked and independent; Phase 4 is cancelled. Pick by what the project needs, and note that 4b is the only user-visible behaviour change in the whole extraction, so landing it while both Telegram implementations are still in one tree is worth more than doing it later.
acceptance_criteria: A PR exists with green CI; the epic branch is not merged directly. The retro verifies drift actually fails for each contract. The next phase has child ticks and a complete EPIC-SKELETON.
